deployment_evidence.note: Technical deployment only. Does not establish editorial or aesthetic approval.

production_pause_reason: User rejected the posted Reel's visuals and narration on 7 November 2026. Automation must not reuse the generic static fish/wave template or direct eSpeak narration.

blocked_fallbacks: publishing degraded media to meet a quota
quality_gate.resume_rule: Keep both scheduled tasks disabled until the replacement full-video benchmark is explicitly accepted and its repeatable production path is tested. Approval concerns one template/voice standard, not weekly manual editing. A voice sample alone is not full-video acceptance. After approval, use the exact accepted narrator and template version; never silently substitute a cheaper or simpler renderer. If a component fails, hold the post and report the failure.

quota_policy: Before each new schedule reconcile all observable published and queued content, including manually created posts, with stable IDs and uncertain reservations. Preserve monthly observations; never invent zero history or exceed 20. No upgrade.
publication_policy: Current quality hold overrides earlier autonomous authorisation. No new public posts until replacement benchmark acceptance. Continue to require original-paper verification, public-media checks, duplicate checks, source references and quota checks. Never claim link-in-bio until confirmed.
